# A method called through the `#id` of a node a block built at run time holds
# reaches that node where the call is in the block too, on every target: a
# reactive `if`'s branch, a tab's panel, and a component spliced into one
# whose two-way prop is bound, which holds no cell of its own. The block is a
# component of its own (passHandleBlocks), holding the node and the handler
# that calls it, as the Pokédex's `asked` was written to be by hand; what the
# handler writes of the page's is raised to the page, which writes it.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func look(k string, life async.Lifetime) async.Result[string] {
    return {ok=k}
}

component branch ui.node {
    var on = false
    var loads = 0
    var tries = 0

    ui.vbox {
        if on {
            async.query #ask(on="a", fetch=look, @load(v) { loads = loads + 1 })
            ui.button #again(text="Again", @click {
                tries += 1
                ask.refresh()
            })
        }
    }
}

func testACallInABranchReachesItsNode(t test.Test, c branch) {
    c.on = true
    t.wait(func() => c.loads == 1, 2000)
    if c.again != null {
        c.again.click()
    }
    t.wait(func() => c.loads == 2, 2000)
    t.assert(c.tries == 1)
}

component panel ui.node {
    var at = 1
    var loads = 0

    ui.tabs(:selected=at) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            ui.text("first")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Two") {
            async.query #ask(on="a", fetch=look, @load(v) { loads = loads + 1 })
            ui.button #again(text="Again", @click { ask.refresh() })
        }
    }
}

func testACallInATabReachesItsNode(t test.Test, c panel) {
    t.wait(func() => c.loads == 1, 2000)
    if c.again != null {
        c.again.click()
    }
    t.wait(func() => c.loads == 2, 2000)
}

component asked(:value option[string] = null, @loaded()) ui.node {
    async.query #ask(on="a", fetch=look, :value=value, @load(v) { loaded() })
    if value != null {
        ui.button #again(text="Again", @click { ask.refresh() })
    }
}

component bound ui.node {
    var on = false
    var got option[string] = null
    var loads = 0

    ui.vbox {
        if on {
            asked #it(:value=got, @loaded { loads = loads + 1 })
        }
    }
}

func testABoundSpliceReachesItsNode(t test.Test, c bound) {
    c.on = true
    t.wait(func() => c.loads == 1, 2000)
    t.assert(c.got == "a")
    if c.it != null && c.it.again != null {
        c.it.again.click()
    }
    t.wait(func() => c.loads == 2, 2000)
}

ui.window {
    branch()
}
